hook: This page has been quiet. That wasn't neglect. We were building.
caption:
This page has been quiet for a long time. That was not neglect — it was building.

PrimeCode Solutions is a software development company based in Phuthaditjhaba. We build websites, web applications and custom software for businesses, schools and organisations, most of them right here in Qwaqwa and the wider Free State.

Over the last while we have been doing the work rather than talking about it. Now we would like to do both.

From here you will hear from us twice a week:
Tuesdays — something useful about technology and business
Fridays — what we are building and how we build it

No jargon. No pretending to be bigger than we are. Just the work.

Follow along.
